name: qa-validation-engine
description: One-repo test automation framework: Playwright + BDD web UI, API contract tests, k6 load tests and Allure 3 reporting, wired into GitHub Actions.

scripts.clean: rm -rf allure-results allure-report test-results playwright-report blob-report k6-results .features-gen
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:api
scripts.allure:web: ALLURE_REPORT_NAME='Web UI' allure generate allure-results/web --clean -o allure-report/web && allure open allure-report/web
scripts.allure:api: ALLURE_REPORT_NAME='API' allure generate allure-results/api --clean -o allure-report/api && allure open allure-report/api
scripts.allure:k6: ALLURE_REPORT_NAME='Load (k6)' allure generate allure-results/k6 --clean -o allure-report/k6 && allure open allure-report/k6
scripts.allure:all: allure generate allure-results/web allure-results/api allure-results/k6 --clean -o allure-report/all && allure open allure-report/all
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:k6 && bddgen
scripts.test:everything: npm run clean && npm run quality && npm run test:all && npm run k6:all
